shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n-- APP FILES --\\n' && for file in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css lib/products.ts next.config.ts; do echo \"== "'$file =="; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$file"; done && printf '"'\\n-- STATUS --\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "node -e 'const React=require(\"react\"); console.log(\"react\", React.version, \"ViewTransition\", typeof React.ViewTransition, \"addTransitionType\",typeof React.addTransitionType)' && rg -n 'viewTransition|view-transition|ViewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -30 && rg -n 'viewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head -45"

/bin/bash -c "node -p 'require(\"react\").version+\" \"+typeof require(\"react\").ViewTransition'; rg -n '\"react\"|\"react-dom\"' package.json | head -10; git status --short; rg -n 'browser back|browser forward|ViewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md | head -25"
/bin/bash -c "git diff --stat && git diff -- app tsconfig.json package.json && git status --short && git diff --check && sed -n '1,100p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,110p' package-lock.json"

/bin/bash -c "git show HEAD:tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,75p' .gitignore && rg -n '\"version\": \"19\\.3|\"version\": \"19\\.1' package-lock.json | tail -8 && command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true && git diff --check"
